Questions

Your Questions, Answered.

Do I have to pay monthly?
No. It is a one-time purchase. Yours permanently. No plan expiry, no upgrade prompts, no surprise charges.
Is there really no limit on QR codes?
No unit limit per workspace. Build a deck of 5 or 500 — the app handles it. Your export is a clean ZIP with a subfolder per unit.
Are the QR codes safe for print production?
Yes. Export vector SVG and follow the scan-safety guidance in the manual to ensure high scannability. The SVG scales to any size without degrading.
Can I edit my QR deck later?
Yes. Export a Project JSON backup, then import it anytime to restore your full workspace — all URLs, labels, and styles. Update and re-export as many times as you need.
What if I change computers?
Export your Project JSON and restore it on any machine. Your deck travels with you, forever.
Where does my data go?
Nowhere. Qreative Studio is fully local-first and runs in your browser. Your project URLs and data are never transmitted to any server. If the service dies, your JSON backup keeps your work intact.
Can I use this commercially?
Yes. Full commercial use is included. Use it for client projects, product packaging, marketing campaigns — whatever you need.
